reasoning: According to overwhelming scientific consensus and established molecular biology, mRNA COVID-19 vaccines cannot alter or permanently change human DNA. As detailed by the National Human Genome Research Institute (NIH) and other leading scientific bodies, mRNA vaccines lack the capability to modify genomic DNA. The mRNA delivered by the vaccine does not enter the nucleus of the cell, where human DNA is stored, and human cells naturally lack the reverse transcriptase enzymes required to convert mRNA back into DNA. Once the cell utilizes the mRNA instructions to produce the target spike protein, the mRNA molecule is rapidly broken down and cleared from the body by cellular processes.
title: mRNA vaccines alter human DNA
